title: Plans and pricing for monday.com – Support
text:
Plans and pricing for monday.com – Support

# Plans and pricing for monday.com

If you're exploring monday.com for the first time (or you're ready to upgrade to a paid product), you’re in the right place! This article will walk you through everything you need to know about how our pricing works: what products we offer, which plans are available, how seats are structured, and how to complete your purchase. 

 Tip: If you'd like to learn the product's exact pricing, check out our pricing page. It provides a comparative list of features and gives an idea of what you need. 

# Sign up

When you sign up for monday.com, you’ll automatically start a 14-day free Pro plan trial of the product you've chosen. You can start exploring or add more products by clicking the grid icon (the nine dots in the top-right corner of your screen), then selecting "Explore more products" to enter the Product store:

Note: Free trials can’t be extended. If you need more time, you can either upgrade to a paid plan or downgrade to the Free plan.

# Product pricing 

monday.com now offers four standalone products, each built on monday Work OS and tailored to a specific workflow need.

 Click to view the products: 

- monday AI work platform: A flexible workflow system that helps teams track tasks, manage projects, and collaborate at scale. 
- monday CRM: A centralized platform to manage leads, contacts, sales pipelines, and customer relationships. 
- monday dev: Built for software development teams managing sprints, roadmaps, and product feedback. 
- monday service: A unified platform that connects ticketing, operations, and cross-functional teams in one place.

Each of our products is individually priced based on the features and functionality available. You can choose to purchase any of the monday products individually or bundle multiple products together, depending on your organization’s needs.

When bundling, each product can be on a different plan and have a different number of seats, but all products must share the same billing cycle, whether monthly or yearly.

 Note: For Enterprise accounts, all bundled products must be on the Enterprise plan. The Enterprise plan is available with a minimum term of 12 months. 

# Plans and features

monday AI work platform and monday dev offer four paid plans: Basic, Standard, Pro, and Enterprise. monday CRM offers the following plans: Basic, Standard, Pro, and Ultimate. monday service offers its plans starting from the Standard and does not include a Basic plan. 

 Tip: The Free plan is only available on monday AI work platform, and provides the basics to get started with the platform. 

To explore features and differences by product, check out our detailed plan type articles:

- Available plan types on monday AI work platform
- Available plan types on CRM
- Available plan types on monday dev
- Available plan types on monday service

# Choose the subscription duration

You can choose between monthly and yearly subscriptions. The yearly option includes an 18% discount over monthly billing.

 Tip: Use the toggle at checkout to see how your total changes based on billing frequency. 

# Choose the number of seats

The pricing works per group of seats and not per seat. We call this bucket pricing. Our pricing plans start at a minimum of 3 seats, and then ascend in multiples of 5. If you have a team of 4, for instance, you should choose the 5-seat option. And if you have a team of 6, you will need to select the 10-seat plan. The price will display per month for the number of seats you select.

 Note: The number of seats you can select at checkout is based on the number of users currently active in your account. If you try to choose fewer seats than you're using, those options will appear greyed out. To select a smaller plan, you'll need to deactivate users first. 

 Tip: Guest seats are counted differently from member seats. To learn more, check out Pricing for guests. 

# Payment and confirmation

When you're ready to purchase, go to your profile picture at the top right of the platform and click "Upgrade". This will open the purchase screen for the product you're currently using.

From there, review your plan, seats, and billing preferences. Enter your payment details and submit your purchase. You’ll receive a confirmation email summarizing your selection and the amount charged.

monday CRM is our dedicated platform for sales and customer-facing teams. It’s a tailored software solution that enables revenue teams to improve efficiency at every stage of the customer journey.

### Basic

Cost: $12 seat /month billed annually

The basic plan is great for teams wanting a simple system to organize their leads, contacts, and deals. In this plan, expect:

- Unlimited customizable pipelines 
- Unlimited contacts: Build a database to store all your contacts without limits.
- Templates for lead, contact & deal management: Use any of our ready-made CRM-specific templates to jumpstart your workflows.

It’s important to note, however, that no automation or integrations are included in this plan, so if you want to save time by automated manual work, you’ll need to upgrade to the next plan.

### Standard

Cost: $17 seat /month billed annually

This plan is excellent for teams that need to improve their efficiency further by automating sales processes and streamlining communication. It includes

- 2-way email integration with Gmail and Outlook: Connect your Gmail or Outlook account to track client communication in one streamlined place.
- AI email generator: Use AI capabilities to write and edit emails.
- Activity management: Automatically log all activities, such as calls, meetings, and more, right within the platform.
- Merging of duplicate data: Identify & merge any contact or lead duplications to eliminate overlaps in your data.
- Custom CRM automations (250 actions per month): Save valuable time by automating processes with no-code automations.
- Custom CRM integrations (250 actions per month): Connect with popular CRM tools you already use (such as PandDoc and Aircall) to centralize everything in one place.
- 500 AI credits per month per account

### Pro

Cost: $28 seat /month billed annually

With our Pro plan, you can gain access to game-changing features that will save you time and give you valuable insights into your entire sales cycle and forecasting. This plan includes:

- Sales forecasting: Manage, track, and adjust predicted sales revenue
- Email templates: Use pre-defined, customizable email templates 
- Email tracking & automations: Set automated rules & notifications when a lead receives, opens, or replies to an email.
- Sequences: Automate a personalized flow of emails & set task reminders.
- Quotes & invoices: Create & share unlimited, customizable quotes & invoices.
- AI email generator: Use AI-assisted email composition, advanced HTML editing, and customizable email templates.
- Mass emails – Send personalized emails to prospects and leads in bulk for more efficient outreach.
- Google Calendar sync – Integrate with Google Calendar to schedule & manage meetings seamlessly.
- Sales analytics – Gain insights into your pipeline & forecasting with a real-time, fully customizable dashboard.

### Enterprise

Cost: contact sales for a customized quote

Manage everything from pre to post-sales with special enterprise-level features. Expect all the advanced security features we mentioned in the Enterprise work management plan, in addition to the following:

- Account management: Track the onboarding progress of your clients & manage renewals.
- Documents for sales: Create a library of all the documents you need to close deals, including legal, security, and more.
